hero.title: One stage. Ambitions. Your voice.
hero.description: Discover the candidates, their journeys, and their social projects. Support the one whose commitment and personality inspire you.

editionInfo.title: 20th Edition Key Information
editionInfo.subtitle: A transparent framework timestamped in the Africa/Douala timezone and validated server-side.
editionInfo.ruleValue: 1st vote free (verified account) · From 2nd vote: 100 XAF / vote

votingFlow.sectionSubtitle: A clear voting journey verified server-side, without misleading technical claims.
votingFlow.step1Desc: Review each candidate's background, social cause, and official motto before making your choice.
votingFlow.step2Desc: Sign in and verify your email address with the 6-digit verification code to unlock your 1st free vote.
votingFlow.step3Desc: Review the official summary. Your vote is atomically recorded on the server without duplicate risks during network drops.
votingFlow.honestyNote: Transparency note: a verified email account confirms inbox ownership but is not biometric proof of a unique physical person.

candidates.catalogSubtitle: Explore the 6 candidates of the 20th Edition, their professions, and their social commitments.
candidates.searchLabel: Search by name, candidate number (1 to 6), region, or city
candidates.noResultsDesc: Try adjusting your search keywords or resetting the active filters.
candidates.qrSubtitle: Scan to open this candidate's public page directly (no secrets embedded).

voteModal.title: Confirm Your Vote
voteModal.freeVoteRuleText: 1st vote free (1 valid free vote per verified account for this edition)
voteModal.paidVoteRuleText: Additional paid vote: 100 XAF per vote (starting from the 2nd vote)
voteModal.nonModifiableWarning: Important: once confirmed and validated by the server, your free vote cannot be modified or transferred to another candidate.
voteModal.alreadyUsedFreeTitle: Your 1st free vote has already been used
voteModal.alreadyUsedFreeDesc: According to the 20th Edition rule, the 1st vote is free and starting from the 2nd vote the rate is 100 XAF per vote.
voteModal.paidDisabledTitle: Paid Voting Option (100 XAF) — Disabled for Security
voteModal.paidDisabledDesc: In accordance with our security charter, online payment (100 XAF from the 2nd vote) remains disabled until a certified payment gateway and signed webhooks are configured by the organizer. No fake payment is simulated.
voteModal.neverAskPinNotice: Security: never enter your Mobile Money PIN or secret wallet password on any website.

leaderboard.title: Public Vote Leaderboard
leaderboard.subtitle: Calculated exclusively from valid votes recorded server-side.
leaderboard.hiddenDesc: The organizing committee has hidden the leaderboard during this stage of voting. Hidden totals are never exposed by the public API.
leaderboard.tieNotice: Tie Policy: candidates with identical valid vote totals share the exact same rank until an official tie-breaking rule is applied.
leaderboard.juryDisclaimer: Regulatory reminder: the candidate leading the public vote is not automatically the final winner if the rules include an official jury evaluation.

auth.title: Authentication & Verification
auth.subtitle: A verified email account is required to record your vote on the server.
auth.verifyDesc: Enter the 6-digit code generated by the server to activate your voting eligibility.
